notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin (blog index is short but readable). Shepherd publishes no prices; its general-practice page says 'Pricing is discussed during a demo', so every dollar figure and price basis is unverifiable, C10 (quote or demo pricing) is true, and C11 ('public' starting price) is wrong (judgement call: the vendor routes pricing to demos and lists none). C12 (per-user SaaS model) is wrong against 'Your subscription always includes Unlimited users'; no cited page read carries it. The founding year 2016 and the March 2025 Hippo Manager acquisition are not on the pages read (about page, blog index), so unverifiable. 'Founded/created by a veterinarian' (C19) was coded only where answers used founding or creating wording; 'designed by' or 'built by veterinarians' lines were treated as product descriptions. Several Shepherd answers in other vendors' bundles (for example q2 Claude and q8 Claude 2) are not in this vendor's bundle under the release matching rule and were not coded here. Cause pages read: layer3labs.io (reused snapshot from the ezyVet vendor; cause of C11), vetclinictech.com, co.vet comparison and eunoiaconsultingco.com (none carries a per-user model for Shepherd). Ratings, outage reports, ease-of-use and support-quality lines were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): the manifest has no browser reads for Shepherd and no claim was unverifiable because an own page was blocked or thin, so nothing was re-classed; re-checking all own snapshots settles none of the unverifiable claims (no price, founding year, Hippo Manager, Sheppy, message-credit or app text). Gap and table review added one instance: C13 q8 Claude 3 ('multi-DVM practices that don't have to pay extra for staff usage'). The remaining gap lines and the vendor-column table cells are features, fit opinions, revenue claims, review scores, statements about Digitail, or the same claim already listed for the same answer; 'Often described as independent or PE-owned depending on source' (q8 Perplexity 2) is hedged and was not coded. Consistency check: C11 kept wrong (the FAQ answer to 'What's included, and what costs extra?' is 'Pricing is discussed during a demo.' and the site navigation has no pricing page; this rests on the vendor's statement of how it discloses price, not on a published figure, so a reviewer may prefer unverifiable); C12 kept wrong (per-user pricing against 'Unlimited users' always included, same unit).
